Hi Sanjay — quick technical notes and the curl test you'll run once we seed the key.

1) When we seed the key we'll send it via the console secure message (and post a short-lived copy in 1Password if you prefer). Do not paste the key into chat/email.
2) Example curl (replace <SEED_KEY>):

curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SEED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "open-embed-64", "input": ["test document"]}'

3) If you plan to test larger batch sizes, let me know target qps; I'll adjust the rate limit on the key.

Also creating a short-lived support token for our internal debugging hooks; will share only after activation.

-Dev

Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
